name: social-poster
description: Post content drafts and pull engagement analytics for Instagram and X from any agent

tools.name: post_draft
tools.description: Post an approved content draft to a connected platform (instagram or x); requires user confirmation before posting

params.name: text
params.describe: The post copy (max 280 chars for x)

params.name: media_url
params.describe: Optional image/video URL for the post

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Fetch engagement metrics (impressions, likes, replies) for a post or account-level summary on a platform

params.name: post_id
params.describe: Specific post id; omit for account-level summary

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List the pending content drafts available for posting
